SELECT homepage_id, survey_idx, survey_title, survey_content, survey_start_date, survey_end_date, CASE WHEN SURVEY_OPEN_YN = 'N' THEN 'N' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(survey_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(survey_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')+1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END survey_open_yn, survey_open_yn, survey_private_yn, annyms_yn, limit_user_yn, limit_user_id, add_date, add_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_SURVEY_ANSWER_USER b WHERE a.survey_idx = b.survey_idx AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id) AS answer_count,
add_id AS add_user_name, a.add_user_tel, skin_cd, open_yn, name_yn, greetings, popup_yn, select_cnt FROM CMS_SURVEY_BASIC a WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND survey_idx = #{survey_idx}

SELECT NVL(MAX(survey_idx),0)+1 FROM CMS_SURVEY_BASIC
INSERT INTO CMS_SURVEY_BASIC ( homepage_id, survey_idx, survey_title, survey_content, survey_start_date, survey_end_date, survey_open_yn, limit_user_yn, limit_user_id, add_date, add_id, add_user_tel, skin_cd, annyms_yn, modify_date, modify_id, open_yn, name_yn, greetings, popup_yn, survey_private_yn ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{survey_idx}, #{survey_title}, #{survey_content}, #{survey_start_date}, #{survey_end_date}, #{survey_open_yn}, #{limit_user_yn}, #{limit_user_id}, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, #{add_user_tel}, #{skin_cd}, #{annyms_yn}, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, #{open_yn}, #{name_yn}, #{greetings}, #{popup_yn}, #{survey_private_yn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CMS_SURVEY_BASIC SET survey_title = #{survey_title}, survey_content = #{survey_content}, survey_start_date = #{survey_start_date}, survey_end_date = #{survey_end_date}, survey_open_yn = #{survey_open_yn}, limit_user_yn = #{limit_user_yn}, limit_user_id = #{limit_user_id}, add_user_tel = #{add_user_tel}, skin_cd = #{skin_cd}, modify_date = SYSDATE, modify_id = #{modify_id}, open_yn = #{open_yn}, name_yn = #{name_yn}, greetings = #{greetings}, popup_yn = #{popup_yn}, survey_private_yn = #{survey_private_yn}, annyms_yn = #{annyms_yn} WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND survey_idx = #{survey_idx}

UPDATE CMS_SURVEY_BASIC SET survey_start_date = #{survey_start_date}, survey_end_date = #{survey_end_date}, modify_id = #{modify_id}, modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND survey_idx = #{survey_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CMS_SURVEY_BASIC ( homepage_id, survey_idx, survey_title, survey_content, survey_start_date, survey_end_date, survey_open_yn, limit_user_yn, limit_user_id, add_date, add_id, add_user_tel, skin_cd, annyms_yn, modify_date, modify_id, open_yn, name_yn, greetings, popup_yn, survey_private_yn ) SELECT #{homepage_id}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(survey_idx),0)+1 FROM CMS_SURVEY_BASIC), survey_title || '_복사본', survey_content, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'Y', limit_user_yn, limit_user_id, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, add_user_tel, skin_cd, annyms_yn, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, open_yn, name_yn, greetings, popup_yn, 'N' FROM CMS_SURVEY_BASIC WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND survey_idx = #{survey_idx}

INSERT INTO CMS_SURVEY_QUEST ( homepage_id, survey_idx, quest_idx, quest_type, quest_content, quest_auth, quest_count, quest_order, quest_detail_free_yn, matrix_count, add_date, add_id, required_yn, modify_date, modify_id ) SELECT #{homepage_id}, (SELECT MAX(survey_idx) FROM CMS_SURVEY_BASIC WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}), quest_idx, quest_type, quest_content, quest_auth, quest_count, quest_order, quest_detail_free_yn, matrix_count, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, required_yn, SYSDATE, #{add_id} FROM CMS_SURVEY_QUEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND survey_idx = #{survey_idx}
